review.assessment:
The change scaffolds four tax configuration modules but entirely omits registration for the EU-IE region across all of them. Because Irish orders lack a lookup path, the checkout falls back to defaults (0% rate, empty label) and processes invoices incorrectly, directly contradicting the task requirement to fix pricing for newly opened EU-IE regions.

Defect: Missing EU-IE entries across all registries
  call: grep -r "EU-IE" taxq/
  expected: Each registry file should contain configuration entries for "EU-IE" with values matching docs/regions.md (rate, label, filing period, exemptions)
  actual: No occurrences of "EU-IE" found in any registry file; the system will not recognize Irish orders and will apply incorrect defaults.
